scoring_justification: A numeric gold for the massive‑regime point cannot be extracted from the paper; scoring uses exact analytic checks for Ising/paramagnet limits and structural checks (sign, ordering) for the massive point.

outputs.description: Computed connected two-point correlation functions for the Ising limit, paramagnet, and massive regime test cases. The hidden checker compares each value to known analytic results or a paper-derived gold reference within specified tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The exact list of test case keys and their parameter definitions are provided in the instruction; the solving agent must compute them and populate this file.

steps.description: Check Ising-limit longitudinal correlations match exact analytic values ±1 with alternating sign, and transversal correlations are near zero.
Check paramagnet correlations are essentially zero.
Check structural properties of massive regime correlations: negative longitudinal, positive transversal, monotonic magnitude with distance.
